notes: Image-to-video model (fal-ai/luma-dream-machine/ray-2/image-to-video). Cost per video: $0.50 for a 5-second clip at 540p (equivalent to $0.10/second); 9-second clips scale proportionally. Resolution options: 540p, 720p (2x base cost), 1080p (4x base cost). Six aspect ratios: 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9, 9:21. Supports both single-image animation and dual-image interpolation via image_url and end_image_url parameters (keyframe control). Optional loop parameter for seamless infinite playback. Input formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF via URL or upload. Output: MP4 video. Commercial use permitted via fal partnership. Competitors: Luma Dream Machine Image to Video ($0.05), Kling Video v2.6 Pro ($0.25), Pixverse v5.5 ($0.10).
